descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B19 · P1 · 已知

保留 / 清理没有按 UAT 3.6 实现：13 小时的重点事项、37 小时的任务 / 交接 / 体征都还在；医生不打开 app 就不清；超过 500 个病人时会漏清

票：TFA-94699 in progress · 算 QA bug：否（票在做） · 在哪发现：本地

注：一个根因让 19 条用例都挂了；保留时长本身怎么定，见待决策 D6

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：OAT-04/S01, OAT-04/S04, OAT-04/S07, OAT-04/S11, OAT-04/S14, OAT-04/S15, OAT-04/S17, OAT-04/S23, OAT-04/S24, OAT-04/S26, OAT-04/S27, TC-10/S21, TC-11/S25, TC-12/S05, TC-13/S15, TC-13/S16, TC-12/S29, TC-13/S29

思路 / Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S08 「36 h 窗口 ±1 h（医院）、同一个面板里新旧混合，以及昨天的转写 / 上一份记录一直探到 67 h」 36 h windows ±1 h (Hospital), mixed ages inside one panel, and yesterday's transcript / previous note probed up to 67 h

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U10 Records clear exactly at their window: each item is still present just before its window ends and gone just after it.（UAT OAT-04 Expected 1；TFA-94699 AC 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U4 Hospital vitals, labs and imaging are deleted 36 h after they were last refreshed: a vital and a lab not refreshed for 37 h are gone.（UAT OAT-04 (B)；UAT OAT-04 step 1；UAT 3.6；UAT 3.7；TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: vitals, labs, imaging 36 h)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U5 Hospital active medication rows are deleted 36 h after their last mention: an active row not mentioned for 37 h is gone.（UAT OAT-04 (B)；UAT OAT-04 step 1；UAT 3.6；TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: active med rows)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U6 Hospital held and stopped medication rows are deleted at 36 h, and a held row's clock restarts each time the chart is processed: a held row not refreshed for 37 h is gone.（UAT OAT-04 (B)；UAT OAT-04 step 1；UAT 3.6；TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: held/stopped med rows)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U7 Hospital open tasks are deleted 36 h after the chart was last processed: an open task on a chart not processed for 37 h is gone.（UAT OAT-04 (B)；UAT OAT-04 step 1；UAT 3.6；TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: open tasks)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U8 Handoffs are deleted 36 h after they were sent: a handoff sent 37 h ago is gone from the database, for sender and recipient alike.（UAT OAT-04 (B)；UAT OAT-04 step 1；TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: handoffs 36 h after sent)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • T3 Hospital encounter dictation and note leave the working tabs at 18 h, are kept as yesterday's transcript / previous note until 36 h, and are then deleted.（TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: encounter, note)；UAT 3.6） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • T7 Vitals, labs and imaging always show their recorded date and lab trends display as in the prototype. The display is tested in TC-13 / TC-19 (policy A); …（TFA-94699 AC 3；UAT 3.7） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U11 Live patient data never survives past its window: once an item clears, no copy of it remains anywhere live (other fields of the chart, dated histories, the patient-list row, handoffs, drafts). …（UAT OAT-04 Expected 2；UAT 3.7 (retention claim)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Patient E aged 35 h and patient L aged 37 h for: the last vitals, lab and imaging refresh; the last mention of an active row; the last refresh of a held row and the last chart processing; an open task. One handoff sent 35 h ago and one sent 37 h ago. …

When The purge runs at each probe; raw rows read with admin access

Then E: everything present. L: everything absent from the database (handoff per Q20). M: Cr, BP and the CXR gone; K, HR and the CT kept, each with its own recorded date. T: yesterday's transcript and previous note present at 35 h; 37 h judged per Q4; absent at 55 h and at 67 h

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：OAT-04 (B), UAT 3.6 and the TFA-94699 table: 35 h present and 37 h absent, per item = pass; a 35 h item gone (too early) or a 37 h item present in any form = Fail. Handoff: its text and every patient's content in it absent = pass; a surviving row may hold only the fields Q20 allows (for example sender, recipient, sentAt). …

在哪跑：本地 retention（改时钟看保留期）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（blocked）

S08 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-04.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条；要拍板的人：Daniela / Tim。

问题分类：已知产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-94699 in progress

37 小时时未完成任务和完整交接都还在；面板上只要有一个新值，旧的化验、血压、胸片就都留着，数值也不带各自的记录日期；昨天的笔记 35 小时就没了；床旁转录到 55–100 小时还在病历上。

At 37 h the open task and the full handoff are still there; on a panel with one fresh value the older lab, BP and CXR stay, no value shows its own recorded date, yesterday's note is already gone at 35 h, and the bedside transcript is still on the chart at 55–100 h.

依据：allure 27340d48-…-result.json; retention lane. 28 checks pass, 14 fail: 11 known (K2, K3, K4, K5, and per-value recorded dates not on main), plus 4 policy conflicts (T.any55, T.any67, T2.day1at67, T2.day1at100). The transcript is kept per stay by design (transcriptArchive.ts:92-95; lifecycle.ts has no 'transcript' branch), the same conflict as dev report §3 (U17). Recorded: Q7 (one clock per panel) and Q4.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane retention。

Tickets: TFA-94699 Data Retention & Purge (in progress)

本地新 lane retention：retention/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（retention/plan.json，automatable: yes）：API spec: E 35 h / L 37 h for vitals, lab, imaging, active row, held row (+ chart processing), open task; handoffs 35 h / 37 h; boundary charts at 36 h -1/+1 min; M with mixed ages built stepwise (Cr then K two hours ago etc.) and judged per value + recorded date (T7); T probed at 19, 35, 37, 55, 67 h by shifting the chart's clocks between purges. Patient T / T2: transcriptDate (the live transcript column's day) moves with the chart: after every step the spec sets the exact day of the tracked moment (T0 - age) with the helper's set, because a day stamp has no time of day and the helper's day shift (exact for one move of a today stamp) drifts over several steps. Transcript items still present at 55 / 67 / 100 h are judged against the UAT and tagged as a policy conflict (transcriptArchive.ts:92-95 per-stay policy; no 'transcript' branch in lifecycle.ts). — Clocks move with the helper between probes; Q4/Q7/Q20 parts recorded.
